# Implementation Plan: Authentication v1

**Branch**: `002-authentication-v1` | **Date**: 2026-06-08 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/002-authentication-v1/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit-plan` command. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Implement Authentication v1 for the PrioraScan workshop platform. The feature enables pre-provisioned users to log in, establish a secure session via JWT cookies, refresh their session silently, and log out. The system enforces protected routes on both backend API and frontend pages, resolves roles/permissions and tenant context into the JWT, and distributes CSRF tokens for mutating requests. Registration, password reset, SSO, MFA, and user administration are explicitly excluded.

**Technical approach**: NestJS backend with JWT in HTTP-only cookies, double-submit CSRF protection, NestJS Throttler for rate limiting, Next.js frontend with TanStack Query auth hooks, Axios interceptors for silent token refresh, and middleware for protected route redirection.

---

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5.x

**Primary Dependencies**:
- Backend: NestJS 10+, `@nestjs/jwt`, `@nestjs/throttler`, `cookie-parser`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`
- Frontend: Next.js 14+, React 18+, TanStack Query, Axios, React Hook Form, Zod

**Storage**: N/A for Auth v1 (no User table in scope; mock credential validation)

**Testing**:
- Backend: Jest + Supertest (unit, integration, contract, security)
- Frontend: Jest + React Testing Library (unit, integration, security), Playwright (E2E)

**Target Platform**: Web application (workshop desktop/tablet)

**Project Type**: Web application (backend + frontend monorepo)

**Performance Goals**:
- Login response < 500ms (p95)
- Token refresh < 200ms
- CSRF token generation + distribution < 100ms

**Constraints**:
- No self-registration, password reset, SSO, or MFA in v1
- No user administration or role management UI in v1
- Role-to-permission mappings are hardcoded or minimally configured
- Refresh token invalidation is expiry-only (no server-side revocation store)
- Password hashing deferred to future administration module

**Scale/Scope**: Supports pre-provisioned users per organization. Stateless JWT; no session store.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design.*

### Pre-Design Gate

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Documentation First | ✅ | PRD, SAD, Frontend Architecture exist and are referenced |
| II. Design Before Implementation | ✅ | Feature spec exists; this plan is the design artifact |
| IV. Modular Development | ✅ | Authentication is isolated; no Vehicle Management dependency except shared guards |
| VI. Multi-Tenant First | ✅ | `organizationId` embedded in JWT; TenantGuard enforces scoping |
| VII. API First | ✅ | All capabilities exposed via REST API; frontend consumes API only |
| XII. Security By Default | ✅ | JWT HttpOnly cookies, CSRF, rate limiting, RBAC, tenant isolation |
| XIV. Git & Change Safety | ✅ | Feature branch `002-authentication-v1`; main is protected |
| XV. Simplicity Over Complexity | ✅ | No SSO, no MFA, no registration, no user admin |
| XVI. Backend-Centric Business Logic | ✅ | All auth logic, validation, RBAC, tenant resolution in backend |

### Post-Design Gate (Re-evaluated)

| Check | Status | Justification |
|-------|--------|---------------|
| Feature does not contradict PRD, SAD, or Frontend Architecture | ✅ | Authentication in PRD Section 6; SAD defines actors and JWT; Frontend Architecture defines `/login` route |
| Multi-tenant boundaries defined for all new entities | ✅ | `organizationId` in JWT payload; TenantGuard resolves from JWT; no cross-tenant access |
| API contracts specified before backend implementation | ✅ | `contracts/auth-api.yaml` and `contracts/auth-api-errors.yaml` define endpoints, schemas, and error codes |
| AI features include explainability and human-confirmation | N/A | No AI in Authentication v1 scope |
| No PrioraFlow dependency introduced for core workflows | ✅ | Auth operates standalone; no external identity provider |
| Error handling and audit logging included in design | ✅ | Error contract documents all auth error codes and status codes |

**Gate Result**: ✅ PASSED. All constitutional requirements are satisfied. No violations require justification.
